### Load packages

```{r load-packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(Biostrings)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(dplyr)
  library(rprojroot)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(rtracklayer)
})
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir-paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-novel-mirna-target-prediction")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
```

### Set GTF file path 

```{r file-paths}
gtf_file <- file.path(data_dir, "gencode.v39.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
```

### Create TxDb and extract 3′ UTRs

```{r create-txdb}
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf_file, format = "gtf")
three_utrs <- threeUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)
```

### Load the genome reference and extract sequences

```{r extract-sequences}
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
valid_chroms <- intersect(seqlevels(three_utrs), seqnames(genome))

three_utrs_filtered <- keepSeqlevels(three_utrs, valid_chroms, pruning.mode = "coarse")
utr_seqs <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, three_utrs_filtered)
```

### Save 3′ UTR sequences to FASTA

```{r save-fasta, message=TRUE}
utr_fasta_path <- file.path(results_dir, "gencode.v39.3utr.fa")
writeXStringSet(utr_seqs, filepath = utr_fasta_path)
message("✅ Saved 3′ UTR FASTA: ", utr_fasta_path)
```

### Generate FASTA of DE Novel miRNAs

```{r get-novel-de-mirnas}
# Get unique novel DE miRNAs across DIPG/DMG, MB, EPN, and LGG
tumor_files <- c(
  "DIPG or DMG_sig_DE_miRNA_list.csv",
  "EPN_sig_DE_miRNA_list.csv",
  "MB_sig_DE_miRNA_list.csv",
  "DESeq2_LGG_vs_healthyNormal_sig.csv"
)

novel_de_mirnas_all <- tumor_files %>%
  file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-mirna-expression", "results", .) %>%
  lapply(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  lapply(\(df) df %>% filter(grepl("Novel", miRNA)) %>% pull(miRNA)) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()
```

```{r write-novel-de-mirnas-fasta}
# Read and combine novel miRNA annotation tables from both batches
batch1 <- read_tsv(file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-mirna-expression", "results", "30-931106737-all_novel_miRNA_merged_id.tsv"), col_types = cols())
batch2 <- read_tsv(file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-mirna-expression", "results", "30-1075661268-all_novel_miRNA_merged_id.tsv"), col_types = cols())

mirna_df <- bind_rows(batch1, batch2) %>%
distinct(merged_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Filter for DE novel miRNAs only
mirna_filtered <- mirna_df %>%
filter(merged_id %in% novel_de_mirnas_all)

# Convert mature miRNA sequences to FASTA
mature_mirna <- RNAStringSet(mirna_filtered$mature_seq)
names(mature_mirna) <- mirna_filtered$merged_id

# Save FASTA file
output_fasta <- file.path(results_dir, "novel_de_mirnas.fa")
writeXStringSet(mature_mirna, filepath = output_fasta)

cat("✅ Saved FASTA with", length(mature_mirna), "novel DE miRNAs to:", output_fasta, "\n")
```

### Run miRanda

```{r}
# Run miRanda
de_mirna_fa <- file.path(results_dir, "novel_de_mirnas.fa")
miranda_out <- file.path(results_dir, "human_miranda_output.txt")
cmd <- sprintf("miranda %s %s -sc 140 -en -20 -out %s",
               de_mirna_fa, utr_fasta_path, miranda_out)
message("🚀 Running miRanda...")
system(cmd)
message("✅ miRanda completed. Results: ", miranda_out)
```

### Parse and Annotate miRanda Results

```{r parse-annotate-miranda-results}
annotated_csv <- file.path(results_dir, "human_miranda_output_parsed_anno.csv")

# Parse miRanda raw output
lines <- readLines(miranda_out)
pred_lines <- lines[str_detect(lines, "^>>")]
fields <- str_split_fixed(str_sub(pred_lines, 3), "\t", n = 10)

parsed_df <- tibble(
  Seq1        = fields[,1],  # miRNA
  Seq2    = fields[,2],  # target
  Max_Score   = as.numeric(fields[,5]),
  Max_Energy  = as.numeric(fields[,6]),
  Len1        = as.integer(fields[,8]),
  Len2        = as.integer(fields[,9]),
  Positions   = str_trim(fields[,10])
)

# Read GTF and build transcript–gene mapping
gtf <- import(gtf_file)
transcript_anno <- gtf[gtf$type == "transcript"]

transcript_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(transcript_anno)) %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name)

# Join annotations and export
miranda_annotated <- parsed_df %>%
  left_join(transcript_df, by = c("Seq2" = "transcript_id")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GeneID = gene_id, GeneSymbol = gene_name)

write_csv(miranda_annotated, annotated_csv)

message("✅ miRanda results parsed and annotated: ", annotated_csv)
```
